_comment: E6 — card-container patterns for stacked-link detection.
Rule 9: these are page-builder-specific editorial strings, not logic.
Add a class here when a builder wraps cards in a container TalkingToad
MATCHING IS TOKEN-BOUNDED, NOT SUBSTRING (2026-09-01). A pattern matches a
class that equals it, or starts with it followed by '-' or '_'. 'entry'
matches 'entry-card', never WordPress's 'hentry' — a bare substring test
made <main class='... hentry'> a card and turned this check into 'any URL
linked twice anywhere on the page'. See
Class patterns alone can never be trusted: the structural guards below are
what actually hold when the next theme invents a new name.
